column1: # docs/project/tickets.tsv — THE TICKET INDEX of Vampire Saved Rebuilt. Every bug, cosmetic item and evolution, one
# row per GitHub issue of DefinitelyFrenchName/VampireSaved-Rebuilt. THE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR THE LIST (CLAUDE.md
# [VSR-29]); a ticket's STORY is its GitHub issue, and what it established lives in the documents its row names.
# Live documents name a ticket by its number and never restate its status. The four answer columns let the tree be
# understood without GitHub: repro (how to reproduce it, or `none`), decided (what was ruled, and where it is
# recorded), learned (where the lesson is written), wrong (what went wrong in handling it, or `none`). `?` marks an
# answer not yet known. Columns, tab-separated:
#   number  kind (bug|cosmetic|evolution)  status (open|done|declined|parked)  title  repro  decided  learned  wrong
#   sessions (the R-NNN keys that worked on it)
